'''2000 UK National Championship Gary Carman DS''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Gary Carman]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds116.htm Efficient Dealing], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040718041904/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds116.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
